## Build, watch or play

From this directory, run `./build.sh`, then `./watch.sh`. Use `./watch.sh --verify-only` for a verification without opening the player. Where a starting save is retained, `./play.sh --label "My attempt"` records an alternative human continuation and adds it to this report. Historical cases lacking a recording/save explain that limit instead of inventing playback.

## Evaluation and diagnosis

The [overall assessment](overall-assessment.md) answers the owner's report with
39 actual frame boundaries,21 original native inventory/prayer/screen anchors,
and a separately qualified read-only private gate/cache trace. Three explicit
retreats to a down stair are followed by exploration north into adjacent mold
melee; the fourth exposure kills. No attack occurs in the tail. The trace
observes persistent fleeing/descent flags false and exceptional-mode danger
cache reuse by normal exploration. No successful alternative is established.

The two starting Cure Serious Wounds were sold; Recall is at Home, the last
Phase was spent, and nine spare torches remain. Only Call Light and Detect
Evil were learned, with no healing prayer. Unknown living potions must not be
relabeled using postmortem identification.
